tasks.title: Survey existing dataset landscape and benchmarks
tasks.description: Map existing datasets in the target domain, catalog their sizes, annotation types, licensing, and known limitations.

tasks.title: Analyze benchmark gaps and community needs
tasks.description: Identify what current benchmarks fail to measure, under-represented scenarios, and community requests from papers and forums.

tasks.title: Design dataset schema and scope
tasks.description: Define data schema, taxonomy, target scale, domain coverage, and inclusion/exclusion criteria.

tasks.title: Define annotation protocol and quality criteria
tasks.description: Design annotation guidelines, inter-annotator agreement targets, quality control checkpoints, and tooling requirements.

tasks.title: Prepare source data and annotation tools
tasks.description: Collect raw source data, set up annotation platform, prepare seed examples and annotator training materials.

tasks.title: Build and run data collection pipeline
tasks.description: Implement automated and manual data collection, deduplication, filtering, and format normalization.

tasks.title: Execute annotation and adjudication
tasks.description: Run annotation rounds, compute inter-annotator agreement, resolve disagreements, and finalize labels.

tasks.title: Validate dataset quality and run baseline experiments
tasks.description: Compute dataset statistics, run baseline models, verify label consistency, and perform bias audits.

tasks.title: Write the dataset paper
tasks.description: Draft dataset paper covering motivation, construction methodology, statistics, baselines, and usage guidelines.

tasks.title: Create datasheet and documentation
tasks.description: Write Datasheets for Datasets, model cards for baselines, README, and license documentation.

tasks.title: Generate dataset figures and visualizations
tasks.description: Create distribution plots, annotation examples, comparison tables, and schema diagrams.

tasks.title: Simulated peer review
tasks.description: Three-reviewer simulation focusing on dataset novelty, construction rigor, and reproducibility.

tasks.title: Audit all citations
tasks.description: Verify every reference exists, check cited claims, flag fabricated references.

tasks.title: Create presentation slides
tasks.description: Generate academic slide deck showcasing dataset design, statistics, and baseline results.
